execution.adflow_line: This is a parallel executable running on 6 processors.
execution.solver: RANS SA, ANK then NK, L2Convergence 1e-8

forces.note: Same reference contract as the C03 canary, so these are comparable.

acceptance_question.definition: surface cp must not exceed the isentropic stagnation bound 1.0018 at M 0.0837
acceptance_question.method: physical interior cells only; rind planes separated and reported apart, because a rind value is not a physical value

reader_validated_against.result: 364 of 38544 values over the bound, peak cp 2.765
reader_validated_against.why: a known-positive control: the reader detects the defect where the defect is known to exist, so a clean report on S8 would be a real negative

result_tip_cap_interior.note: The cap is clean and better resolved than forecast. y+ of 10 s0 was a conservative proxy; measured y+ is at most 4.2 because cap shear is low.

rind_planes.note: reported for completeness and excluded from the verdict

acceptance_question.verdict_detail: The defect is not gone. 30 of 4416 physical OML wall cells still exceed the bound, by at most 0.1706. But it is 25.4 times smaller in magnitude and 68 times smaller in extent than C03, and the leading-edge collar as a distinct contaminated strip no longer exists because there is no collar.

open_questions: Is the residual 0.17 excess a resolution effect? The decisive and cheap test is to rebuild oh_L3 with target_le_turn_deg 6 instead of 10 at the same n_side: a pure chordwise redistribution, identical cell count and memory. If cp_max falls toward 1.02 it is resolution and the family converges.

cp_min of -9.4975 sits on the tip cap at the tip leading edge, x 0.4159 y 0.9784. Suction has no isentropic upper bound so this is not automatically wrong, but it is a strong local peak at the 90 degree corner where the OML meets the cap, and it should be checked against a refined tip before any tip claim.
oh_L2 at 1.06M cells needs 11.2 GiB and oh_L1 at 2.32M needs 24.6 GiB against 15.3 GiB on this host, so a full grid-convergence study cannot run here. It needs the desktop or a coarser family.
